rows.en:
I decided to go see Iwashita.
But after that whole business yesterday, she had gone home partway through, and somehow I felt awkward about going to her.
Still, I had to confirm that Arai existed.
I tracked down Iwashita's classroom and peeked inside.{p}

There was no sign of Iwashita.
I asked a girl who was standing near the doorway.
"...Um, is Iwashita here?"
"Oh.
Akemi? She's absent today.
Do you need something?"
"Ah, no.
Sorry to bother you."{p}
{f:I|I} decided to go see Iwashita.{p}

I found her classroom and peeked in. Iwashita was leaning on a desk with her hands, lost in some vague thought.
"Iwashita!"
When {f:I|I} called out, Iwashita slowly turned around.
Then, wearing that chilling, eerie smile of hers, she beckoned {f:me|me} over.{p}

{f:I|I} stood beside her and spoke in a low whisper.
"...Um, it's about Arai."
"The doll story?"
If Iwashita was bringing up the doll story, then {f:it really|it really} hadn't been my dream.
{f:Iwashita|Iwashita, too,} had heard Arai's story{f:.|!}
"No, more than that... I just asked Hino about it a moment ago.
Apparently he never invited anyone called Arai.
Worse, he says he doesn't even know anyone like that."
{f:I|I} was hoping for some reaction from Iwashita, {f:but|but} she was perfectly calm and not the least bit surprised.{p}
"Oh, is that so? Well, what does it matter?
After all, I've been seeing dolls this whole time."{p}

"Huh★"
"This world is full of dolls.
Everyone but me is a doll.
You're a doll too.
...Look, there's a doll behind you as well."{p}
Relieved, I turned back to Iwashita. She was smiling like a little devil.{p}
I couldn't tell how much of what she said was serious.{p}
{f:I|I} decided to look for Kazama.{p}

I looked, but he wasn't there.
I was sure this was the place, but...{p}

"Boo!"
Suddenly, two hands covered my eyes from behind.
"I am the devil's messenger."
The words were whispered right in my ear.
"Kazama!
Quit fooling around."
I shook off the hands and turned around.{p}

"Aaah!"
There stood a giant cockroach...
Yeah, right. There's no way something like that exists.
I pulled off the tasteless mask shaped like a giant cockroach.{p}

Kazama's smirking face emerged from inside the cockroach.
"Ahaha... You're as boring as ever, you know.
At this rate, you'll never be a hit with the girls like I am.
And here I was, going to teach you how to get girls."
Talking with this guy always throws me off.
"Don't tell me you're mad that I left partway through?
Come on, nobody likes a guy who can't take a joke."
So he really had just gone home early.
People don't just suddenly vanish.
"I know.
As a special favor, I'll teach you a gag that'll make the girls love you.
Right now it's a special bargain, just five thousand yen.
So, how about one?"{p}
"That's enough, thanks."{p}
I ran out of the classroom without listening to Kazama.{p}
{f:I|I} headed for Kazama's classroom.{p}

I looked, but he wasn't there.
I was sure this was the place, but...{p}

"Boo!"
Suddenly, two hands covered my eyes from behind.
"I am the devil's messenger."
The words were whispered right in my ear.
"Kazama!
Quit fooling around."
{f:I|I} shook off the hands and turned around.{p}
"That's enough, thanks."{p}
{f:I|I} ran out of the classroom without listening to Kazama.{p}
{f:I|I} decided to look for Fukuzawa.{p}

Fukuzawa looked worried again.
She seemed to be connecting this with the way {f:I|I} had acted last night.
"...What's wrong? Is your head okay?"
"Just answer {f:me, okay|me}.
{f:We|We} definitely heard the doll story from Arai{f:, right|, didn't we}?"{p}
Fukuzawa, perhaps overwhelmed by how intense {f:I|I} was, gave a small nod.{p}
{f:Just as I thought|So I was right}, Fukuzawa had seen him too{f:.|.}{p}
{f:I|I} decided to go see Shindo.{p}

When I went to Shindo's classroom, no one was there.
It {f:seemed|looked like} everyone had already gone home.{p}

{f:It can't be helped|Oh well, it can't be helped}.
{f:Guess I'll give up on Shindo|I'll just have to give up on Shindo}.{p}
{f:I|I} decided to look for Hosoda.{p}

"Bwahahahaha... Hosoda?
Hosoda's probably in the john, ain't he?
That guy's always hangin' out in the john.
Go look in the toilets!
Bwahahahaha..."{p}

"Whoa!"
Just as I turned to leave the classroom, {f:I|I} slammed into Hosoda's huge body.
Hosoda was wiping his hands on a handkerchief, beaming.
Apparently he had just finished his business in the toilet.{p}
Hosoda was grinning from ear to ear.{p}

"Hey, if it isn't {a}{f:|}!
I'm so happy! Did you come to see me?
We really are best friends!"
With that, he threw his arms around {f:my|my} shoulders.{p}

At that, Hosoda let go of {f:me|me}, and suddenly he looked creeped out.
"Please don't bring up that story.
I'm trying hard to forget it myself.
Still, that Arai has a nasty streak, doesn't he...
Telling a story like that and scaring everyone."
"So you did hear Arai's story!"
When {f:I|I} pressed him, Hosoda backed away as if startled.{p}

"What's gotten into you, {a}{f:|}...?"
"Hosoda, did you know Arai from before?"
"...No, I only met him for the first time yesterday.
We're in the same year, but I'd never seen Arai before.
Then again, there are so many students at this school, so I guess it can't be helped."{p}

Hosoda tilted his head, puzzled.
"Thank you very much."{p}
Saying only that, {f:I|I} left Hosoda's classroom.{p}

"Um, is there someone named Kiyose in this class?"
"That's me. Why?"
A voice came from the corner of the classroom, and someone walked over.
So he was Kiyose{f:?|?}
"Who are you?"
"Um, {f:I'm|I'm} {b} {a}, from the newspaper club, and..."
"Sorry!"
Before {f:I|I} could finish introducing myself, he suddenly pressed his palms together and bowed his head deeply.{p}

"Man, you're Hino's junior, right?
I'm sorry.
Yesterday I suddenly came down with a fever.
It got so bad that I went home early.
I feel bad about it.
Next time I'll tell you my very best scary story... What's wrong, spacing out like that?"
"Oh, {f:no|no}, {f:sorry|I'm sorry}."
This time it was {f:me|me} bowing my head to Kiyose.{p}
Find out
Let's forget it

{f:I|I} made the rounds of every second-year classroom.
And I learned one fact.
There was no one named Shoji Arai among the second-years.
{f:In that case|Then}, who {f:was he|was he}?
I'd search again.
Maybe one of the classrooms had been empty when I checked.
{f:I|I} must have {f:overlooked him|missed him}.
Whatever it took, I {f:had to|had to} find out.{p}

"{a}!"
Just as {f:I|I} was about to go around the second-year classrooms again, a voice behind me called out to stop me.{p}

Shindo came up to {f:me|me} and muttered with a sigh.
"...So, how'd it go?
Did you find Arai?"
Shindo too...?
Shindo couldn't find him either{f:?|?}
{f:I|I} honestly shook my head.
"...I see.
Come over here a sec."{p}

"Looks like there's no guy named Shoji Arai in the second year at our school."
Shindo's words completely shattered {f:my|my} faint hope.{p}

"...Yesterday, after all that, it kept bugging me, so I did some digging.
And guess what.
Looks like that doll story he told is actually true.
Apparently every year, one person always gets sacrificed and dies.
So I went looking for Arai to beat the crap outta him for saying that stuff, but he's nowhere to be found.
There's no such guy among our students.{p}

...Hey, {a}.
Are you listening to me?"{p}

...{f:I|I} had bigger things to worry about.
Something was visible behind Shindo.
It was a doll, no doubt about it.
A life-sized doll with a brown face was staring at {f:me|me} through the classroom window.
"What're you lookin' at, {a}?"
Bothered by where {f:I|I} was looking, Shindo turned around.
But Shindo apparently couldn't see {f:it|it}; he just kept glancing all around.{p}

"What's wrong with you, {a}!"
By the time Shindo shook me, the doll was already gone.
"...It's nothing.
Hearing your story just made me feel a little sick, that's all."
Shindo seemed to believe {f:me|me}{f:.|.}{p}

"I see.
Be careful.
Anyway, don't believe a word that guy said.
There's a ton of students at this school.
No way one of us is gonna end up the sacrifice."
It sounded less like he was saying it to {f:me|me} and more like Shindo was telling it to himself.
With that, Shindo clapped {f:me|me} on the shoulder and walked off.{p}

...It started after that.
That {f:I|I} began seeing the doll often.
A life-sized doll with a brown face and big eyes.
It was quite different from the one in Arai's story, but he'd said its appearance depends on who sees it, so the doll in front of {f:me|me} right now must be the one{f:.|.}
For a while now, the doll has been standing silently in a corner of {f:my|my} room.
At first I only saw the doll at school, but now it comes all the way to {f:my|my} house.
And the number of times {f:I|I} saw the doll grew by the day.{p}
Quietly wait for death to come
Try my best to connect with the doll
Talk to someone about it
Try going to school once more
